name: BWDL19 rifle
description: The BWDL19 rifle was a model of blaster rifle manufactured during the Galactic Civil War. This variant of the DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle was developed by the Galactic Empire to protect the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on Dathomir. A BWDL19 rifle was discovered in the Quarantine Zone of Dathomir during the Blackwing virus outbreak in 1 ABY.
